title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for streetlight repairs along Jefferson Boulevard in Council District Eight (CD 8).
text:
[Council File 26-1113; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for streetlight repairs along Jefferson Boulevard in Council District Eight (CD 8).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
AMEND the Council action of August 19, 2026, relative to funding streetlight repairs along Jefferson Boulevard for streetlights that were vandalized during construction of the Jefferson Beautiful Active Transportation Program Project (Project) (Council file No. 26-1113) as follows:
1. Increase the approved amount from $485,320 to $729,056.60 from Measure M Fund No. 59C/94, Account No. 94YV63 (Active Transportation Program Project Funding Gaps).
2. Authorize the use of $24,244.92 from the CD 8 Public Benefit Trust Fund, Account No. 2027/49F/14/14E004 (Adams-Normandie On Demand Maintenance and Capital Improvements), for Project material and labor costs for the Project section of Jefferson Boulevard between Van Buren Place and Vermont Avenue.
3. Authorize the total Project budget of $753,301.52 be transferred / appropriated as outlined in the table contained in the Motion.
4. Instruct the Bureau of Street Lighting (BSL) to submit expenditure documentation to the Bureau of Engineering (BOE) for review and concurrence when repairs are completed and return any unused funds to their original source (Measure M Fund No. 59C/94 and/or CD 8 Public Benefit Trust Fund No. 49F).
5. Authorize BOE and BSL to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
